issues.on_page: Water 99,470.01 and Solid Waste 16,032.51 printed under Business-Type Activities (lines 45, 48) in the General Fund column
issues.issue: Business-type activity lines (Water, Solid Waste, Wastewater 8,541.60) are recorded as governmental because the General Fund column pays them. This follows the waiver fund-column rule, but 124,044.12 of utility spending lands in governmental totals, and the General Fund 'Local Receipts: Other' 102,646.67 probably holds the matching utility charges. Someone should confirm the treatment.
